man--verb.def: To provide people to operate a place or a machine.
man--verb.ex: Volunteers manned the phones all night.
man--verb.exTr: Gönüllüler bütün gece telefonların başında durdu.

house--verb.def: To provide a place for people or things to stay.
house--verb.ex: The old barn houses the museum collection.

trying--adj.ex: It has been a trying week for the family.
trying--adj.exTr: Aile için yıpratıcı bir hafta oldu.

perfect--verb.def: To make something as good as it can possibly be.
perfect--verb.ex: She spent years perfecting the recipe.

till--noun.def: The drawer in a shop where money is kept.
till--noun.ex: The manager counted the till at closing.

voice--verb.def: To express an opinion or a feeling in words.
voice--verb.exTr: Birkaç üye ciddi endişelerini dile getirdi.

class--verb.def: To place someone or something in a category.
class--verb.ex: The species is classed as endangered.

ground--verb.def: To stop a plane from flying, or to base an argument on evidence.
ground--verb.ex: Fog grounded every flight that morning.
ground--verb.exTr: Sis o sabah bütün uçuşları durdurdu.

hanging--noun.def: A piece of cloth hung on a wall as decoration.
hanging--noun.ex: A woven hanging covered the stone wall.
hanging--noun.exTr: Dokuma bir duvar halısı taş duvarı örtüyordu.

condition--verb.def: To train someone to behave in a particular way.
condition--verb.ex: Years of noise had conditioned him to sleep through anything.
condition--verb.exTr: Yılların gürültüsü onu her şeye rağmen uyumaya şartlandırmıştı.

signal--verb.def: To make a movement or a sound that gives information.
signal--verb.ex: The driver signalled before turning left.
signal--verb.exTr: Sürücü sola dönmeden önce işaret verdi.

contract--verb.def: To become smaller, or to agree formally to do work.

firm--verb.def: To become more solid or more certain.
firm--verb.ex: The jelly firms up in the fridge.

desert--verb.def: To abandon a person or a duty, especially in the army.
desert--verb.ex: Two soldiers deserted before the battle.
desert--verb.exTr: İki asker savaştan önce firar etti.

sacrifice--noun.def: Something valuable that you give up for a greater purpose.
sacrifice--noun.ex: Her parents made real sacrifices for her education.
sacrifice--noun.exTr: Ailesi eğitimi için gerçek fedakârlıklar yaptı.

sacrifice--verb.def: To give up something important for a better purpose.
sacrifice--verb.ex: He sacrificed his weekends to finish the book.
sacrifice--verb.exTr: Kitabı bitirmek için hafta sonlarını feda etti.

campaign--verb.def: To work in an organized way towards a political aim.
campaign--verb.ex: They campaigned for cleaner water for a decade.
campaign--verb.exTr: On yıl boyunca daha temiz su için kampanya yürüttüler.

stock--verb.def: To keep a supply of goods for sale.

tone--verb.def: To make muscles firmer through exercise.

recall--noun.def: An official request to return a faulty product, or the ability to remember.
recall--noun.ex: The company issued a recall of two thousand cars.
recall--noun.exTr: Şirket iki bin araç için geri çağırma başlattı.

launch--noun.def: The start of a new product, or the sending of a rocket.
launch--noun.ex: The launch was delayed by bad weather.

removed--adj.def: Distant from something in nature or in experience.
removed--adj.ex: His theory is far removed from daily life.

contest--verb.def: To argue formally that a decision is wrong.
contest--verb.ex: The family contested the will in court.

chill--verb.def: To make something cold without freezing it.
chill--verb.ex: Chill the wine for an hour before serving.
chill--verb.exTr: Şarabı servis etmeden bir saat önce soğut.

chill--noun.def: A feeling of cold, or a sudden feeling of fear.
chill--noun.ex: There was a chill in the evening air.

tune--verb.def: To adjust an instrument or an engine so it works correctly.
tune--verb.ex: The mechanic tuned the old engine.

woo--verb.def: To try to win someone's support or affection.
woo--verb.exTr: Parti genç seçmenlerin gönlünü kazanmaya çalıştı.

shed--verb.def: To lose leaves, hair or skin naturally.
shed--verb.ex: The trees shed their leaves early this year.
shed--verb.exTr: Ağaçlar bu yıl yapraklarını erken döktü.

angle--verb.def: To turn something so it points in a particular direction.
angle--verb.ex: She angled the lamp towards the page.

absolute--noun.def: A principle that is true in every situation.
absolute--noun.ex: In ethics there are few absolutes.

engineer--verb.def: To arrange something cleverly, often secretly.

drill--verb.def: To make a hole with a tool, or to train by repetition.

trauma--noun.def: A severe shock that has a lasting effect on the mind or the body.

brief--verb.def: To give someone the information they need before a task.
brief--verb.ex: The officer briefed the team at dawn.

commission--verb.def: To formally ask someone to produce a piece of work.
commission--verb.ex: The city commissioned a new statue.
commission--verb.exTr: Şehir yeni bir heykel siparişi verdi.

wicked--adj.def: Morally very bad, or playfully mischievous.
wicked--adj.ex: The story has a wicked stepmother.
wicked--adj.exTr: Hikâyede kötü kalpli bir üvey anne var.

jersey--noun.def: A shirt worn by a sports team, or a knitted top.
jersey--noun.ex: He kept his old team jersey.

jersey--adj.def: Belonging to a breed of brown dairy cattle.
jersey--adj.ex: They keep a small jersey herd.

clan--noun.def: A large family group with a shared ancestor.

con--verb.def: To trick someone in order to take their money.
con--verb.ex: He conned the old man out of his savings.

con--noun.def: A trick to take money, or a disadvantage in an argument.
con--noun.ex: Weigh the pros and cons carefully.

burst--noun.def: A sudden short period of activity or sound.
burst--noun.ex: A burst of applause filled the hall.

grounds--noun.def: A reason for doing something, or the land around a building.
grounds--noun.ex: She was dismissed on grounds of dishonesty.

humble--verb.def: To make someone feel less important or less proud.

gig--noun.def: A live music performance, or a short piece of paid work.
gig--noun.ex: The band played a small gig on Friday.
gig--noun.exTr: Grup cuma günü küçük bir konser verdi.

goose--noun.def: A large water bird with a long neck.
goose--noun.ex: A goose hissed at the dog.

institute--verb.def: To start an official process or a system.

pace--verb.def: To walk back and forth, or to control your speed.
pace--verb.ex: He paced the corridor for an hour.

verdict--noun.def: The decision of a jury, or a judgement about something.
verdict--noun.ex: The jury reached a unanimous verdict.

naive--adj.def: Too ready to believe things because of little experience.
naive--adj.ex: It was naive to trust a stranger with the keys.
naive--adj.exTr: Anahtarları bir yabancıya emanet etmek safçaydı.

puzzle--verb.def: To make someone confused because something is hard to explain.
puzzle--verb.ex: The symptoms puzzled the doctors for weeks.

plague--verb.def: To cause continuous trouble to someone.
plague--verb.exTr: Sakatlıklar bütün sezon başına bela oldu.

bald--verb.def: To lose the hair on your head.
bald--verb.ex: He began to bald in his thirties.

harbor--verb.def: To shelter someone secretly, or to keep a feeling in your mind.

hack--verb.def: To break into a computer system, or to cut roughly.

hack--noun.def: An act of breaking into a system, or a clever quick solution.
hack--noun.ex: The hack exposed thousands of records.

psychiatrist--noun.def: A doctor trained to treat mental illness.

lust--noun.def: Very strong desire, especially sexual or for power.
lust--noun.ex: The play is about a lust for power.

ego--noun.def: A person's sense of their own importance.

resort--verb.def: To do something unpleasant because nothing else works.
resort--verb.ex: They resorted to borrowing from relatives.

vicious--adj.ex: It was a vicious attack in broad daylight.

corps--noun.def: A large military unit, or a group with a shared job.
corps--noun.ex: The medical corps arrived within hours.

violet--adj.ex: The sky turned violet at dusk.

harvest--verb.def: To gather a crop from the fields.
harvest--verb.ex: They harvest the olives in November.

quest--noun.def: A long search for something important.
quest--noun.ex: His quest for the truth lasted years.

legacy--noun.def: Something left behind by a person or an era.
legacy--noun.ex: The bridge is the legacy of that period.

orphan--verb.def: To leave a child without parents.
orphan--verb.ex: The war orphaned thousands of children.

scenario--noun.def: A description of how a situation might develop.
scenario--noun.exTr: En kötü senaryoya göre plan yap.

isolated--adj.def: Far from other places, or happening only once.
isolated--adj.ex: The village is isolated in winter.

pose--verb.def: To create a problem or a risk, or to hold a position for a photograph.
pose--verb.ex: The old wiring poses a real danger.
pose--verb.exTr: Eski tesisat gerçek bir tehlike teşkil ediyor.

hostile--adj.def: Unfriendly and strongly opposed to someone.
hostile--adj.ex: The crowd turned hostile after the decision.
hostile--adj.exTr: Karardan sonra kalabalık düşmanca bir hâl aldı.

amateur--noun.def: A person who does something for pleasure, not for money.
amateur--noun.ex: The photograph was taken by an amateur.

amateur--adj.def: Done for enjoyment rather than as a paid job.
amateur--adj.ex: He plays in an amateur orchestra.

rally--verb.def: To recover strength, or to come together in support.
rally--verb.ex: The team rallied in the second half.

bloom--verb.ex: The almond trees bloom in February.

bribe--verb.def: To give money illegally to make someone act in your favour.
bribe--verb.ex: He was accused of bribing an official.

bribe--noun.def: Money given illegally to influence someone's decision.

lodge--verb.def: To make an official complaint, or to become stuck somewhere.
lodge--verb.ex: She lodged a complaint with the council.

landscape--verb.def: To improve the appearance of land with plants and paths.
